question.text: Which statement is correct about chemisorptions?

options.text: It involves formation multi layer of adsorbent on adsorbate
It involves the weak attractive forces between adsorbent and adsorbate

solution.text: Chemical adsorption is irreversible due to formation of new strong chemical bonds. It is unilayer due formation of new chemical bonds. It first increases with increase in temperature due to supply of energy of activation then decreases due to breaking of covalent bond.
